YouTube is now paying creators extra cash just for sticking to a regular posting schedule. Basically, your content calendar is about to become your main source of income. Are you posting every single day or just disappearing for three months at a time? Let me know below.

post.news: YouTube launched a Shorts bonus program that pays creators who upload videos at regular intervals.
post.take: Finally, an algorithm that judges your posting schedule just like your Indian relatives.
post.insight: Platforms are moving from random viral hits to rewarding steady habits because consistency keeps users hooked longer.
